name: LLC_TRANSFORMER

ports.name: PRI_P
ports.meaning: Primary winding positive terminal, connects to half-bridge switch node (48V square wave)

ports.name: PRI_N
ports.meaning: Primary winding negative terminal, connects to input ground reference

ports.name: SEC_CT
ports.meaning: Secondary center-tap, connects to +12V output rail

ports.name: SEC_A
ports.meaning: Secondary winding A terminal, connects to synchronous rectifier FET A drain

ports.name: SEC_B
ports.meaning: Secondary winding B terminal, connects to synchronous rectifier FET B drain

notes: Provides galvanic isolation and voltage transformation. Ground and power rails are NOT ports - isolation boundary is the transformer itself.
